text: Then see what happens. If you don’t do it, don’t worry about whether you should have done it until after you have done it. It may be that you didn’t do it because you were afraid, or you had second thoughts, or you didn’t know how to do it, or you were too tired, or any number of practical reasons. Keep those acts that result in your little one being safer or closer to you or more able or having more fun. Just because you don’t feel better when you’ve done it doesn’t mean it wasn’t a good idea to do it. You may still feel better if you don’t let your sister know that you said no, and then check all day to see if she’s answered.
